_description: 60/40 split with different stock (10%) and bond (2%) rates, 0% stddev, 0% inflation, no income/spending. Verifies blended return math.
_rationale: Pure portfolio growth test. 60/40 split, stock return 10%, bond return 2%, both 0% stddev = fully deterministic. Blended return = 0.6*0.10 + 0.4*0.02 = 6.8% per year. With 500k initial savings and no cash flows, balance = 500000 * 1.068^n each year. No spending so never fails.
name: Split Returns Blended
